headerDisplay:
Shows your Mercedes-Benz vehicle's door lock, doors, windows, and fuel/EV level (read-only) in HomeKit. Logs in directly with your Mercedes Me account credentials — no Home Assistant required.

**Security notes:** use a dedicated Mercedes Me account with MFA disabled for this plugin (invite it as an additional driver on your car). Do not use the same account simultaneously in the official Mercedes Me app.
footerDisplay: This plugin uses an unofficial, reverse-engineered API and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mercedes-Benz. Use at your own risk — misuse may result in your Mercedes account being blocked.

username.title: Mercedes Me Email
username.description: Use a dedicated secondary account invited as an additional driver on your vehicle.

vin.title: VIN (optional)
vin.description: Leave blank to auto-discover the first vehicle on the account. Set this if the account has multiple vehicles.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to fetch the latest vehicle status. Matches Mercedes' own app polling interval; do not set too low to avoid rate limiting / account flags.

showFuelBattery.title: Show Fuel Level
showFuelBattery.description: Only created if the car actually reports a fuel level (combustion/hybrid).

showEvBattery.title: Show EV Charge Level
showEvBattery.description: Only created if the car actually reports an EV state of charge (EV/hybrid).

layout.title: HomeKit Services
layout.description: Turn off anything you don't want shown in the Home app. Fuel/EV level services are only created when the car actually reports that data, even if enabled here.
